Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
Second supplementary affidavit filed today in Court, is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Paritosh Shukla, learned counsel for the opposite party No. 2, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants with the prayer to quash the charge sheet dated 30.12.2021 as well as further proceedings of Case Crime No. 0118 of 2021,
under Sections 498-A, 323, 506, 328, 376 IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Quarsi, District- Aligarh,
pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Aligarh.
As per the allegation made in the first information report, it is alleged that on 4.12.2019 at about 8 p.m., applicant- Anoop Kumar entered in the room of opposite party No. 2 and after giving some Hemant And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46132942/
1 stupefying substance committed rape on her.

sentences.text:
Subsequently, when this fact was disclosed to her husband, mother in-law and sister in-law, they asked her to keep mum and started making demand of dowry and thereafter for non-fulfilment of demand of additional dowry, they used to torture her,
maltreated her and subjected her to cruelty and turned her out of her matrimonial home.

Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that from the perusal of the allegations made in the FIR and the material collected during the course of investigation, no offence is disclosed against the applicants and the present case has been instituted with a malafide intention for the purpose of harassment, as such, impugned charge sheet, summoning order as well as entire criminal proceedings be quashed.

Per contra, learned AGA as well as counsel for the opposite party No. 2 has submitted that from the perusal of the allegations made in the FIR and the material collected during the course of investigation, prima facie offence is clearly made out against the applicants and as such, impugned charge sheet, summoning order as well as entire criminal proceedings cannot be quashed.

Having considered the rival submissions made by learned counsel for the parties and from the perusal of the allegations made in the FIR and the statement of the witnesses and material collected during the course of investigation prima facie, offence is clearly disclosed against the applicants.

At this stage, disputed question of fact cannot be considered, therefore, in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the cases of R.P. Kapur Vs. State of Punjab, AIR 1960 SC 866, State of Haryana Vs. Bhajan Lal, 1992 SCC (Cri.) 426, State of Bihar Vs. P.P. Sharma, 1992 SCC (Cri.) 192 and lastly Zandu Pharmaceutical Works Ltd. Vs. Mohd. Saraful Haq and another, (Para-10) 2005 SCC (Cri.) 283,
